visual_action: A montage of video clips shows a bearded seal in an arctic environment. The seal is seen lying on a large piece of floating ice in the water. There are close-up shots of its face and wider shots of it on the ice floe as it looks around and lies down.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: On-screen text: "trump is letting big oil drill right into the Bearded Seal's habitat". Caption: "trump has opened up 1.6 million acres of the Alaskan Wildlife Refuge ...".

cast.name: big oil
cast.evidence: On-screen text: "trump is letting big oil drill right into the Bearded Seal's habitat".

on_screen_text.text: trump is letting big oil drill right into the Bearded Seal's habitat

spoken_summary: A female vocalist sings lyrics from a song: "So why do we run... to the ones we do? I don't belong to anyone."
audio_music: A somber, atmospheric female vocal track ('David' by Lorde) plays throughout the video, creating a melancholic and sad mood.
editing_pacing: Slow cuts between various B-roll shots of a seal in its natural habitat.
cultural_references: The background music is the song 'David' by Lorde.
central_claim: Donald Trump's policy of allowing oil drilling in the Alaskan Wildlife Refuge is destroying the natural habitat of the bearded seal.
intended_effect: To evoke sympathy for the endangered animal and anger towards Donald Trump's environmental policies.
